# TRL-PARSE-0004: Invalid UTF-8 replaced

- Severity: warning
- Exit class: none
- Area: PARSE
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Re-save the file as UTF-8. Lossy decoding is reported, never silent.
